newsitem.title: USA: Warm, high pressure building in Brazil coffee belt.
newsitem.headline: Warm, high pressure building in Brazil coffee belt.

text.p: A warm, subtropical ridge of high pressure is expected to build into the coffee belt from northeast Brazil over the weekend, Weather Services Corp said in an update on Wednesday.
According to WSC, this pattern should hold through the early part of next week. "This is a mild pattern for the coffee belt with no threat of cold weather," WSC said.
Partly to variably cloudy skies with a few light showers were observed in the region this morning. Low temperatures were in the 50's F (10-15 C).

Variable clouds with the chance of scattered showers will continue for the rest of today. Partly cloudy skies and a few light showers are expected for Thursday and Friday. Temperatures should be near to above normal levels with lows in the 50's F (low to middle teens C).
The extended outlook calls for fair to partly cloudy skies through the beginning of next week with temperatures remaining near to above normal.
